description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for three models, mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM, across various categories. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with values ranging from L4+ to R4+, in the order: L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+. The vertical axis is labeled "Shapley value" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 20. Each category has a grouped set of three bars, representing the three models, with mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in dark blue, and chLSTM in green. The bar heights vary across categories and models, with the tallest bar, chLSTM, in category T, reaching approximately 78, and the shortest bars, across multiple categories, having values close to 0. The bars are grouped by category, with the three models represented side by side. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
